Can I get consistent social media management from Fiverr?
Consistency is Fiverr’s biggest weakness for social media management. Every gig is a one-off transaction with a different freelancer, different quality standards, and different turnaround times.
How much does Fiverr social media management cost for real estate?
Fiverr social media management gigs for real estate range from $30 to $205 per order — but that typically covers only one task like graphic design or caption writing.
Does Fiverr specialize in real estate social media?

No. Fiverr is a general freelance marketplace. Most sellers handle clients across dozens of industries and have no deep understanding of real estate marketing, local market trends, or compliance requirements.
Does Fiverr include video editing for real estate agents?

Video editing is available on Fiverr as a separate gig you purchase individually. You find a freelancer, negotiate scope, upload footage, wait for delivery, request revisions (often limited), and repeat the process every time.
